'''Aron Rodrigo Tapia''' (born 10 July 2004) is a professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Midfielder#Winger|winger]] for Spanish club [[CD Mirandés]], on loan from [[FC Andorra]]. Born in Spain, he plays for the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].

==Career==
Born in [[Lleida]], Catalonia, Rodrigo began his career at the age of 14 with hometown side UE Bordeta de Lleida. After representing [[Lleida Esportiu]], he spent one season back at Bordeta before spending the 2021–22 season with {{ill|Atlètic Segre|ca}}, aside from debuting as a senior with affiliate side Atlètic Alpicat in [[Segona Catalana]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://elperiodic.ad/esports/lfc-andorra-aposta-pel-futbol-de-pais-i-aron-rodrigo-es-converteix-en-el-primer-reforc-de-cara-el-quart-any-professional/|title=L’FC Andorra aposta pel futbol de país i Aron Rodrigo es converteix en el primer reforç de cara el quart any professional|trans-title=FC Andorra bet on the football of the country and Aron Rodrigo becomes the first signing ahead of the fourth professional year|publisher=[[El Periòdic d'Andorra]]|language=ca|date=1 May 2026|accessdate=6 July 2026}}</ref>

On 27 July 2023, after finishing his formation with [[CE Europa]], Rodrigo agreed to a deal with [[Tercera Federación]] side [[CD Binéfar]].<ref>{{Cite Instagram |author=CD Binéfar |user=cdbinefar |postid=CvNUgfBMvyK |date=27 July 2023 |title=🔵⚪️ 𝐂𝐎𝐌𝐔𝐍𝐈𝐂𝐀𝐃𝐎 𝐎𝐅𝐈𝐂𝐈𝐀𝐋 {{!}} 📝 Aron Rodrigo, nuevo jugador del Club Deportivo Binéfar para la próxima temporada 23/24 |trans-title=🔵⚪️ 𝐎𝐅𝐅𝐈𝐂𝐈𝐀𝐋 𝐒𝐓𝐀𝐓𝐄𝐌𝐄𝐍𝐓 {{!}} 📝 Aron Rodrigo, new player of Club Deportivo Binéfar for the upcoming 23/24 season |language=es |access-date=6 July 2026 }}</ref> Roughly one year later, after being regularly used, he joined [[SD Huesca]] and was initially assigned to [[SD Huesca B|the reserves]] also in the fifth division.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sdhuesca.es/noticias/aron-rodrigo-desborde-y-verticalidad-para-el-ataque-de-la-sd-huesca-b|title=Arón Rodrigo, desborde y verticalidad para el ataque de la SD Huesca B|trans-title=Arón Rodrigo, skill and verticality for the attack of SD Huesca B|publisher=SD Huesca|language=es|date=31 July 2024|accessdate=6 July 2026}}</ref>

On 4 July 2026, Rodrigo signed a three-year contract with [[FC Andorra]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcandorra.com/en/news/aron-rodrigo-welcome|title=Aron Rodrigo, national product for the first tricolor team|publisher=FC Andorra|date=4 July 2026|accessdate=6 July 2026}}</ref> but was loaned to [[Primera Federación]] side [[CD Mirandés]] on 4 August.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcandorra.com/en/news/aron-rodrigo-loaned|title=Aron Rodrigo, loaned to Mirandés|publisher=FC Andorra|date=4 August 2026|accessdate=4 August 2026}}</ref>

==International career==
After representing [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] at [[Andorra national under-21 football team|under-21 level]], Rodrigo received his first call-up to the full side on 6 November 2024, for the [[2024–25 UEFA Nations League D]] matches against [[Moldova national football team|Moldova]] and [[Malta national football team|Malta]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.aragondigital.es/articulo/sd-huesca/andorrano-huesca-b-aron-rodrigo-convocado-absoluta/20241106114725894036.html|title=El andorrano del Huesca B Arón Rodrigo, convocado con la absoluta|trans-title=The Andorran of Huesca B Arón Rodrigo, called up to the senior national team|publisher=Aragón Digital|language=es|date=6 November 2024|accessdate=6 July 2026}}</ref> He made his full international debut on 21 March 2025, starting in a 1–0 [[2026 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)|FIFA World Cup qualifiiers]] loss to [[Latvia national football team|Latvia]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eldiariodehuesca.com/deportes/ian-olivera-barbastro-aron-rodrigo-huesca-b-titulares-con-andorra_30573_102.html|title=Ian Olivera (Barbastro) y Arón Rodrigo (Huesca B), titulares con Andorra|trans-title=Ian Olivera (Barbastro) and Arón Rodrigo (Huesca B), starters with Andorra|publisher=El Diario de Huesca|language=es|date=21 March 2025|accessdate=6 July 2026}}</ref>
